prompt_meta.title: True RC Pass: Production Web Build + Deterministic Web E2E + Android Emulator + iOS Simulator + Real Mobile E2E + Evidence + GitHub push

owner_actions.when: only if macOS prompts require password/TouchID/permissions (e.g., installing Android Studio tools, accepting Xcode license, Apple ID login dialog)
owner_actions.instruction: Approve system dialogs only. Do NOT run any commands manually.
Approve ops/RELEASE_CANDIDATE_CHECKLIST.md results (must show all journeys PASS).

step_objectives.goal: Convert E2E + simulator validation into a true, automated, reproducible RC PASS that is acceptable before App Store / Play Store GA packaging.
outcomes: apps/web production build passes reliably (no ETIMEDOUT trace issue)
Playwright E2E passes via actual automated run (not curl/manual assertions)
Android emulator is installed + booted; app launches; evidence captured
iOS Simulator is installed + booted; app launches; evidence captured OR BLOCKED with precise unavoidable reason and remediation that does not require owner commands
Mobile E2E runs on Android emulator (Maestro or IDE-chosen) and passes at least Auth + one core flow
RC checklist is accurate: all_passed=true only when Web E2E + Android E2E + simulator proofs exist
All fixes committed and pushed to GitHub main; CI green
constraints: No new features. Only fix build/test infra and simulator/E2E readiness.
Push provider may remain mock/logging; validate via send-attempt logs + navigation proof.
definition_of_done: pnpm --filter @norijjak/web e2e passes via Playwright automated run
Android emulator runs and app is visible (screenshot proof)
iOS simulator runs and app is visible (screenshot proof) OR step is BLOCKED with exact reason and evidence
ops/RELEASE_CANDIDATE_CHECKLIST.md indicates PASS for all required journeys; no contradictions

critical_journeys_must_pass: Auth: signup -> login -> logout -> session persists -> protected screens gated
Approval joins: request -> approve/deny -> notification created + state reflects
Private invite: token -> redeem -> join works
Venues: list/detail -> create game with venue -> game shows venue
Clubs: create (web) -> join request -> approve -> club-hosted game rule enforced
Chat: send/receive -> block hides messages -> report persists
Ratings: eligible rating -> aggregation shows badges
Push (mock/logging ok): verify send-attempt logs + payload routes match docs

tasks.name: Fix apps/web production build ETIMEDOUT (trace) and make build reproducible
tasks.objective: Make `pnpm --filter @norijjak/web build` succeed reliably in monorepo. Reduce/limit tracing scope and avoid symlink explosions. IDE chooses best Next.js config strategy.
constraints: No skipping build; store packaging depends on prod build

tasks.name: Make Playwright E2E deterministic and truly green
tasks.objective: Playwright must run in automation using a deterministic server strategy (prefer build + start). Eliminate reliance on curl/manual checks.
constraints: No flaky sleeps; use readiness checks/wait-on
acceptance: pnpm --filter @norijjak/web e2e passes as an automated run
Evidence includes Playwright output + trace on failure (if any)

tasks.name: Provision Android SDK + Emulator and boot it
tasks.objective: Install Android SDK tooling, set ANDROID_HOME, create AVD, boot emulator, and run the mobile app on it. Capture screenshot evidence.
constraints: Only allow owner to approve system dialogs if unavoidable

tasks.name: Provision iOS Simulator and boot it (macOS)
tasks.objective: Install/validate Xcode + Simulator tools, accept license, boot iOS Simulator, run the mobile app. Capture screenshot evidence.
constraints: If Xcode download requires Apple ID UI, ask only for dialog approval/login (no commands).
If blocked, capture exact error output and mark BLOCKED with remediation.
acceptance: iOS Simulator running + app launched OR BLOCKED with precise evidence

tasks.name: Run real Mobile E2E on Android emulator (not stubs)
tasks.objective: Execute Maestro (or IDE-chosen equivalent) against the running Android emulator app and pass at least Auth + one core flow (e.g., create game).

tasks.name: Update QA docs + RC checklist with strict truthfulness
tasks.objective: Update ops/QA_PLAYBOOK.md and ops/RELEASE_CANDIDATE_CHECKLIST.md. Ensure rc_checklist.all_passed=true ONLY if all required validations truly executed.
acceptance: RC checklist matches actual executed evidence
Known issues empty or strictly non-blocking

tasks.name: Quality gates + GitHub push
tasks.objective: Run gates + E2E + emulator checks, fix any failures, then commit and push to main with CI green.
acceptance: Commit hash + push evidence in report

rules: Store screenshots and small logs here
Avoid committing huge videos; prefer screenshots + logs

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate any command execution to the owner. Make web production build reliable, make Playwright E2E pass via automated run (no curl/manual claims), provision Android emulator and iOS simulator if feasible, run real mobile E2E on Android (not stubs), capture evidence, ensure RC checklist is truthfully all_passed=true only if everything ran, keep CI green, commit and push to GitHub main, update ops/manifest.json, and write a complete reports/STEP-0017.report.json with no placeholders.
